description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/channels/api.ex and CommunicationBridge/JidoChatBridge/EmailBridge boundary helpers as required. Extend existing :deliver_outgoing path: selected outbound connection -> capability snapshot/shared resolver once -> separate metadata Plan -> executor -> existing confirmation/observation reporting. Keep API thin, transport policy runtime-owned. Preserve publish_tool_steps, canonical versus formatted body, status/streamed-message identity, routing context and trusted actor/opts. Empty attachments retain ordinary delivery behavior.
Requirements-error fallback: approved continue publishes original text without acquiring/uploading rejected files and retains configuration failure facts; abort sends nothing. Derive policy from selected shared FileSettings, not failed resolver output or a bridge-owned resolver. A valid ordinary text connection and applicable encoded limits remain required. Optional unresolved limits are not resolution errors. No selection-failure notice route, Agent selection or notification consumer wiring.
Tests before implementation: API integration through real resolver/executor/bridge/Engine, no-attachment parity, one resolve per attempt, selected SMTP for IMAP, configured failure policy on resolution error, zero acquisition on discarded files, unknown optional limits accepted, actor provenance/permission isolation, provider success plus Engine failure never resends, exactly-once completion callback and correct final provider ID.
Branches: text/file, send/edit, requirements/preparation/publication failure and partial delivery.
Mocking: external HTTP/SMTP only, injected per-call config; internal paths real.
Documentation: Channels data flow and module contracts.
Action reuse: extend existing :deliver_outgoing operation, existing bridges and DeliveryConfirmation; no parallel public send path/Action. Cross-service NodeRouter/Event boundary remains unchanged in ownership.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

PR #970 integration regression requirement (2026-11-27): consume persisted selected-connection state, never BO capabilities_snapshot or FileSettings.validation_capabilities from rejected form saves as runtime truth. New widget creation validates its final normalized live-update policy before insertion; fixture/setup through save APIs must retain that contract and avoid relying on cross-node access to an uncommitted connector. Scope :configuration intentionally permits disabled connectors for editor inspection; actual delivery must retain enabled/authorized runtime connection selection, including selected SMTP for IMAP. Resolve once per attempt after selection, preserve explicit false failure policy, and do not confuse save-error capabilities metadata with per-part delivery failures.
title: [zaq-9j8.7] Wire Channel-local execution into the existing delivery route
